main_text.p: A Christo nato sunt dies quingenties septuagies octies millenæ triginta duo.
A Christo nato sunt horæ tredecies millenæ, millenæ, octingenties septuagies bis millenæ, septingentæ sexaginta octo.
Quando multiplicator est articulus, o non ponitur sub prima nota, sed digitus, & semel tantum dicitur o est o: deinde digitus multiplicatur, hoc modo:

page.notes: Arithmetic displays are set as lines; the digits are placed to the right as printed, and small dots and print marks sit under some digits (under 578032 and 832366080), not transcribed. The paragraph "Quando multiplicator..." contains a small circle "o" as a zero sign after "articulus," and in "o est o", printed as such. A brown stain lies at the right of "578032".
